# Dub Connector for Muse

A Muse agent skill that manages Dub short links: list links, create new ones, update or delete them, read click analytics, and record lead or sale conversions against a click. Creates, updates, deletes, and conversion events are writes — confirm first, unless standing permission exists (deleting a link breaks its short URL). Dub keys are per workspace: a key from one workspace cannot touch another. Uses a Dub API key (`dub_...`, Dub dashboard > API keys), kept in Muse's secure vault. Dub has a free plan. Draft: written from Dub's public API docs, not yet live-tested end-to-end — this listing's unverified status reflects that. No secrets in the repo.
